$comment: Every distribution in this repository that declares a version with no
verified publication tag, with the reason that state is acceptable. Measured by
`scripts/declared_publication_sweep.py`, guarded by
`tests/architecture/test_declared_publication.py`.
## Why this file exists at all
`test_module_version_sync.py` proves a module's three version surfaces
AGREE. It cannot prove the agreed version was PUBLISHED. `dotmac-integration`
reads 0.1.0a2 on all three surfaces and the version-identity guard passes,
while the newest tag is dotmac-integration-v0.1.0a1 — internal consistency
candidate construction and verified publication are different questions;
this ledger owns only the last. A consumer reading the repository, the changelog or
docs/MODULE_CATALOG.md and pinning ==0.1.0a2 gets a resolver error.
## What a row here does and does not mean
A row means the state is KNOWN and someone has said why. It is not
permission to leave it there, and it is emphatically not a reason to edit
the declared version down to match the index: that would make the
repository agree with the registry by discarding the work the number
describes, and the changelog entry for the unpublished version would then
belong to nothing.
The repair is not always a release, either. `dotmac-imports` was reported
as an anomaly BECAUSE it was release-allowlisted with no tag; the ruling
was that the allowlist row was the wrong half, and it was removed rather
than the module published. Two states this file must keep distinct:
* INTENDED — the distribution is meant to be unpublished right now.
The row records the decision so
the next reader does not undo it by dispatching a release.
* OUTSTANDING — a version is genuinely owed to consumers. The row
records evidence a decision still needs. Two worked examples have now
passed through and been removed on release: `dotmac-integration`
0.1.0a2 (released as a3) and `dotmac-kernel` 0.1.0a67. A row that
expires on its own release is the healthiest shape an entry here has.
Both are recorded the same way and neither is a pass. The reason text is
where the difference lives, which is why the guard requires a premise
rather than a label.
## Two directions, both failures
A distribution entering this state without a row fails — that is a version
silently promised to consumers. A row whose distribution has since been
published ALSO fails and must be removed in the same change as the release,
because a ledger that only grows stops describing anything (ADR-0018).
## The oracle is a git tag
The release workflows write a tag only after `verify-registry` has
installed the exact published version from the private index and registered
its manifest, so a tag is this repository's own assertion that a version is
installable — stronger than 'an upload succeeded'. The index is not queried
directly: that needs an authenticated URL, which makes the check
un-runnable at PR time and offline, and a gate that cannot run is not a
gate. The stated cost is that a publication whose tag step failed reads
here as unpublished — which is exactly the state
`recover-module-release.yml` exists to repair, so reporting it is correct.

dotmac-ai-operations.reason: ALLOCATED DEVELOPMENT VERSION, NOT YET PUBLISHED. 0.1.0a1 IS published and tagged (dotmac-ai-operations-v0.1.0a1). 0.1.0a2 adds the stateless advisory-protocol contracts (AIAdvisoryInvocation/AIAdvisoryResult/AIActionProposal/AIActionDecision/AIExecutionObservation/AICapabilityExposureRef) and hardens capability-id/digest binding, so src/ no longer matches the bytes that the a1 tag names and a bare 0.1.0a1 would make one version name two importable surfaces. Remove this row only after an authorized 0.1.0a2 publication is tagged from the exact protected revision; allocation is not publication.

dotmac-deployment-foundation.reason: BUILT ONCE; UNRECORDED AND DRIFTED. 0.4.0a1 was allocated on 2026-09-04 for the new authorized failed-system recovery capability. Run 33920058598 built it once from protected-main source 753a004e7f8dbab034d5d6ca565c680d931a5309 as artifact 9954731961 (built source tree 504bc8f71b62646a5e20a22c41827b20ddd88d33). Its CandidateArtifact.v1 receipt remained in the workflow artifact and never entered this repository; #628 and #631 then changed the facility's importable source under the unchanged version. tests/architecture/candidate_window_baseline.json therefore records both unrecorded and drifted from the external build oracle. 0.4.0a1 is unpublished, untagged and not an admissible rehearsal or publication coordinate; it must not be rebuilt or published. The latest published Foundation remains 0.2.0a2. This row records that tag-level publication fact only: it does not authorize committing the old receipt, writing a disposition, or allocating a successor. Michael has reserved those lifecycle decisions. recover remains absent from authorization.OPERATIONS; Control can issue that operation but Foundation refuses it at AuthorizationReceipt construction before any grant, plan or effect, and no recover-specific settlement contract exists. The predecessor 0.3.0a6 remains a separate never-built name spent by documents, with no receipt or disposition. The earlier 0.3.0a5 candidate remains recorded superseded and publishable=false at CandidateDisposition.v1 sequence 4. Remove this row only through an authorized release-record transition for a valid successor, never by editing the declaration down or treating the drifted a1 artifact as current bytes.

dotmac-inbox.reason: DEVELOPMENT MARKER, DELIBERATELY UNPUBLISHABLE AND NOT A PENDING RELEASE. 0.1.0a2 IS published and tagged (dotmac-inbox-v0.1.0a2). This Inbox capability slice adds explicit snooze-until-reply, late transport-observation correlation, opaque product-supplied thread/message identities and the unreleased ib_0002 migration, so continuing to declare bare 0.1.0a2 would make one released version name two contracts. The local segment allocates no successor, cannot be published and requires no release authorization. Remove this row only by separately ALLOCATING the next public version at release time; never remove the marker merely to quiet a gate.

dotmac-inbox-operations.reason: OUTSTANDING FOR SUB'S IDENTITY-PRESERVING ADOPTION AND THE ADR-0059 AVAILABILITY SLICE. Version a4 added typed historical presence, assignment, queue-entry and cursor imports; a5 adds the four-state availability owner, the browser heartbeat seam, the offline grace/requeue/supervisor-alert policy and the separated claim, cold-transfer, warm-transfer, requeue and escalation commands with their own declared permissions. Source presence is not registry evidence and Sub must not pin it until the protected release installs it back and tags the exact revision. Remove this row in the a5 release-record change, then repin Sub and retire its direct-model exception in the same adoption sequence; do not edit the declared version down.

dotmac-integration.reason: ALLOCATED AHEAD OF SOURCE, TO KEEP THIS GUARD HONEST. a17 IS published (peeled tag dotmac-integration-v0.1.0a17 -> 2cab76b442e6cc6c8ed81a409d943ba250351c3d) and no source in this repository yet differs from those published bytes. a18 is allocated now, before the durable provisioning-runtime work begins, precisely so that source divergence never has to share a version number with a17's published contract -- allocating first is what keeps this guard from becoming the thing it exists to catch. Source presence is not registry evidence. It is NOT to be repaired by editing the version down: remove this row only when the protected module release installs, verifies, registers and tags exact 0.1.0a18; nothing may exact-pin or lock a18 before that tag exists.

dotmac-platform-health.reason: ALLOCATED DEVELOPMENT VERSION, NOT YET PUBLISHED. 0.2.0a1 moves off the published 0.1.0a1 identity because it changes the importable contract: ph_0002 preserves unknown legacy freshness provenance, rebuild and signed-evidence selection refuse unknown provenance, and the public evidence surface and ph_0002 migration are now release contents. dotmac-runner-transport.reason: INTENDED UNTIL THE VMID 124 PILOT RETIRES THE LEGACY WRITER. The one-time local a1 wheel and bundle from 5d6381d were never published or tagged and are INVALIDATED: receipt acceptance did not bind adapter or provider-runner coordinates and accepted arbitrary well-formed evidence digests without the retained bytes. Reusing a1 for repaired bytes would make one version identify two contracts. a2 adds the typed provider-runner identity and canonical lifecycle-evidence documents, binds the adapter through the host specification, and re-hashes every retained document at acceptance. It remains absent from release-facilities.json. Remove this row only after one protected-main a2 bundle drives both repository diagnostics to terminal provider-recorded success, repeats after a cold reboot, and the observed-broker inventory plus its autonomous timer are retired with no_autonomous_return. The unchanged GitHub Actions adapter remains a1 and its >=0.1.0a1 dependency admits core a2. Foundation paths are outside this change.

dotmac-runner-transport-github-actions.reason: INTENDED UNTIL THE GITHUB ACTIONS PILOT PROVES THE EXACT SNAPSHOT. The adapter owns GitHub's current exact actions_inbound full-domain set, including its transitive result-storage names, but is deliberately absent from release-adapters.json until VMID 124 proves control, acquisition, result upload and provider-recorded success through the rendered proxy before and after a cold reboot. Metadata drift never auto-admits a domain. Remove this row only with the reviewed adapter-lane enrollment and pilot evidence; do not replace exact names with Azure CIDRs or a cloud-wide wildcard.
